sources_used: web search UK rhythm/DDR arcade locations (no matches for these seaside/bowling stubs)

findings.name: Arcadian City
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: 舞立方·秀 (DANCE³·Show) (China). Comment: Offline | CN cab with full song list unlike the UDC distributed version. Updated 2026-03-26.
findings.note: Chinese Dance³ rhythm dance cab. Not a listed Bemani/maimai slug; map as other. Venue site describes karaoke/VR/arcade floor at The Arcadian Birmingham.

findings.name: Barnsley Bowl
findings.evidence_quote: Info: Bowling alley in Barnsley with a small selection of arcade games and claw machines. Listed games (updated 2025-04-11): Mario Kart Arcade GP DX, Halo Fireteam Raven, claws, pushers, Crab Rush, Typhoon, hockey, pool. Comments: DDR 5th Mix present historically then 'They recently removed the game there' (9 years ago).
findings.note: DDR historically removed; 2025 visitor inventory is family/redemption only. No current music games.

findings.name: Basingstoke Superbowl
findings.evidence_quote: Mainly bowling and a kids soft play area, arcade is really small and the only thing that isnt a boxer or ticket machine is scarlet dawn. Games: The House of the Dead: Scarlet Dawn. Updated 2025-12-19.
findings.note: Explicit tiny arcade: boxer, ticket machines, one rail shooter only. No rhythm cabs.

findings.name: Bayside Arcade
findings.evidence_quote: Small arcade on the middle promenade in the middle of the funfair rides. Games: No games at this location. Updated 2022-08-30.
findings.note: Empty ZIv stub; silence is not confirmed_none. Bridlington promenade seaside arcade; no independent game list found.

findings.name: Beachcomber amusements
findings.evidence_quote: Your typical seaside arcade, filled with 90% prize/fruit machines and 10% video games. Unfortunately no music games here. Listed: Mario Kart Arcade GP 2, Beach Head 2000, Big Buck Hunter Pro, After Burner Climax, Arm Champs II. Updated 2020-11-30.
findings.note: Positive 'no music games' statement but source is ~5 years old; re-verify if visiting. Confidence unverified due to age.

findings.name: Bibby's
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Mario Kart Arcade GP DX (two of them), NERF Arcade. Comment (2025): and also there's a lot of coin pushers that i didn't bother to snap and list. Updated 2025-04-13.
findings.note: Seaside/redemption inventory; visitor listed video cabs plus many pushers, no music games. Chapel St Leonards.

findings.name: Bicester Leisure Centre
findings.evidence_quote: Mainly a leisure centre but has a bowling alley. Games: Dinosaur King, Sonic & Sega All-Stars Racing Arcade, Key Master, Sega UFO Catcher. Updated 2019-11-06.
findings.note: 2019 inventory only; too old for confirmed_none. No music games listed then.

findings.name: Blackpool Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: Formerly a Woolworths/Poundland, mostly coin pushers but you will find other skill-based games. Extensive list (updated 2026-05-06): World's Largest Pac-Man, Asphalt 9, Cruis'n Blast, Fast & Furious Arcade, Ultra Moto VR, Jurassic Park Arcade, redemption/whackers. No music games.
findings.note: Large recent inventory of pushers/racing/shooters only. Visitors include UK ZIv regulars who typically log rhythm cabs when present.

findings.name: Blackpool Pleasure Beach (Inside Park)
findings.evidence_quote: 3 arcades inside the amusement park. Games listed: Deadstorm Pirates x2, Deal Or No Deal Pusher, Pac-Man Smash. Updated 2024-06-19.
findings.note: Partial inventory for multi-arcade park interior; incomplete coverage so not confirmed_none. No rhythm games in listed subset.

findings.name: Blackpool Tower
findings.evidence_quote: Multiple arcades spread throughout the building. Games: Super Bikes (2P), Aliens: Extermination, Barbercut, Down The Clown, Stacker. Updated 2023-08-26.
findings.note: Multi-floor partial list only; not complete enough for confirmed_none.

findings.name: Bowl Central
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: Guitar Hero Arcade (International). Location: Upstairs, on the left hand side. Price £1.00. Condition Perfect. Updated 2024-06-02. Info: Is now a spiffy bowling alley, but nearly all redemption games now.
findings.note: Guitar Hero Arcade is rhythm but not a named map slug → other. TripAdvisor reviews also mention guitar hero at Bowl Central Bournemouth. Historical ZIv photos show DDR EuroMix2; current games table lists Guitar Hero not DDR. Re-verify live status.

findings.name: Bowl Central Fareham
findings.evidence_quote: Games: VR Agent, Let's Go Island, The House of the Dead: Scarlet Dawn, Claw Machine, Monopoly Roll & Go, Sonic Blast Ball. Updated 2023-06-01.
findings.note: Bowling FEC inventory without music/rhythm. Sister Bournemouth site has Guitar Hero; this Fareham list does not.

findings.name: Bowl Xtreme
findings.evidence_quote: Games: No games at this location. Updated 2017-09-21.
findings.note: Empty ancient ZIv stub for Worcester Bowl Xtreme. No external game list found.

findings.name: Britannia Pier
findings.evidence_quote: Along the pier there is a selection of arcade games and claw machines, as well as a mini bowling alley. Games: Daytona USA (2P), Sega Rally Championship, Jurassic Park Arcade (2015), Terminator Salvation, Hockey Table. Updated 2024-05-19.
findings.note: Great Yarmouth pier: classic racing/shooters only in visitor list. No music games. Related entry z4084 not researched as separate shard id.

findings.name: Broad Farm Touring Caravan Park & Campsite
findings.evidence_quote: Remember very good but dead amusements being here with an EM1. Games: No games at this location. Updated 2020-09-26.
findings.note: Hint of dead amusements / past EM1 only. Could be closed amusements but not proven; leave unknown.

findings.name: Broadland Sands Holiday Park
findings.evidence_quote: Games: No games at this location. Updated 2016-10-23.
findings.note: Holiday park empty ZIv stub, 2016. No usable evidence.

findings.name: Brookes Collectables
findings.evidence_quote: Edit 2023: There are no games here at all. There is one coin operated puppet show however. Games: No games at this location. Updated 2023-08-17.
findings.note: Toy/model shop, not an arcade; visitor confirmed zero arcade machines in 2023. Not closed as a shop, but no rhythm games possible.

findings.name: Bubbles
findings.evidence_quote: Largely redemption. used to have a twin outrun 2 but its now gone. Games: No games at this location. Updated 2020-10-22.
findings.note: Hopton holiday-site arcade; empty ZIv games table, redemption-only note. Not strong enough for confirmed_none.

findings.name: Bugsy's Ten Pin Bowling
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Daytona Championship USA, Super Bikes. Comment: All cabinets are not operating at the moment. Energy-cost note 2022. Updated 2022-09-20.
findings.note: Margate bowling; only racing cabs logged, no music games. Status of power-off arcade may have changed.

findings.name: Butlins (Fairground)
findings.evidence_quote: This is the arcade that runs during fairground hours... Comment: There's not many games here. Listed: Super Bikes 2, Fast and the Furious Super Cars, claws, Down The Clown, Monopoly/Pac-Man pushers. Updated 2023-08-22.
findings.note: Butlins Bognor fairground arcade: racing + redemption only. No music games in inventory.

findings.name: Butlins (Silent Arcade)
findings.evidence_quote: This is the Silent Arcade where most machines are muted. Games: Cruis'n Blast, MotoGP Arcade, Jurassic Park Arcade, claws, Despicable Me Jelly Lab, Duo Drive, Monopoly pushers, Sonic Dash Extreme, Sonic Sports Basketball, etc. Updated 2024-04-30.
findings.note: Bognor Butlins Reds silent arcade: long redemption/racing list, no rhythm/music titles. Also-linked Centre Stage z5086 not in this shard.

findings.name: Butlins Minehead (Reds)
findings.evidence_quote: This is the arcade in Reds. Games: Dead Heat (2P), Sno Cross, Duo Drive, Rainbow, Safari Ranger, Tower of Tickets, Hockey Table. Updated 2023-09-01.
findings.note: Minehead Butlins Reds: racing/redemption only.

findings.name: CHS Frontier Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Fruit Ninja FX. Updated 2015-04-21.
findings.note: 11-year-old single-game Hunstanton stub. Useless for current lineup.

findings.name: Cain's Amusements- Coin Castle
findings.evidence_quote: Long games list updated 2024-04-09: Mario Kart Arcade GP DX, Hungry Hungry Hippos, Deal or No Deal, pushers, NERF Arcade, Pac-Man Smash, Sonic Sports Basketball, etc. No music/rhythm titles.
findings.note: Leysdown Coin Castle (Cain's chain). Comprehensive redemption/video inventory without DDR/SMX/maimai-class games. Grand Piano Keys is a redemption piano, not a rhythm game.

findings.name: Cain's Amusements- Herne Bay
findings.evidence_quote: Comments ~2 years ago: 'StepManiaX isn't present here anymore. Should I remove it?' / 'I visited today, and it wasn't there. I'll go ahead and remove it' / older 'Sorry to see DDR A go'. Current games list (updated 2024-07-29): Cruis'n Blast, Mario Kart, Jurassic Park, Scarlet Dawn, Walking Dead, many pushers; no music games. Photos titled DDR A / Moved DDR A are historical.
findings.note: Had DDR A and StepManiaX; both explicitly removed. Now standard Cain's seaside mix only.

findings.name: Cain's Amusements- Playtime Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: Owned by Cain's Amusements. Very long 2024-04-09 list: Mario Kart, Aliens Armageddon, Jurassic Park, Let's Go Jungle, Walking Dead, many pushers/redemption. No music games.
findings.note: Leysdown Playtime; same chain pattern as Coin Castle. Thorough inventory, no rhythm.

findings.name: Cains Amusements Sheerness
findings.evidence_quote: One of the arcades operated by Cain's Amusements. Games: Big Bass Wheel Pro, Cop The Loot Pusher, Down The Clown, Hammer Head, Pearl Fishery, Pharaohs Golden Temple, Rainbow Riches, Slam-A-Winner, Zombie Outbreak. Updated 2024-01-22.
findings.note: Redemption-heavy Cain's site; no music titles in list.

findings.name: Caister-on-Sea Holiday Park
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Animal Kaiser PLUS, Minecraft Dungeons Arcade, Cruis'n Blast, Mario Kart Arcade GP DX, Spinner Frenzy. Updated 2024-04-19.
findings.note: Holiday park FEC mix; no rhythm games listed.

findings.name: Carousel Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: Comment: DDR Euromix has been removed from here (StaticFish, 7 years ago). Current games (updated 2023-10-19): Super Bikes, Transformers Human Alliance, Bean Bag Toss, Down The Clown, Fire Ball, Ice Man, Lane Master, Monopoly Roll & Go, NERF Arcade, etc.
findings.note: Newquay Carousel: positive historical removal of DDR Euromix; current inventory has no music games.

findings.name: Carousel Amusements
findings.evidence_quote: Games (updated 2025-06-28): Tomb Raider Arcade, Mario Kart Arcade GP DX (Twin), Big Buck Hunter Reloaded, Duck & Dive Mini, Find A Key Deluxe, Monopoly Roll Down, Toy Stack, Trap Door.
findings.note: Sheringham Carousel (different venue from Newquay z3170). Recent non-music inventory.

findings.name: Casino Royale
findings.evidence_quote: Games: No games at this location. Updated 2023-02-23. Address: 47-48 Sandside, YO11 1PG (Scarborough).
findings.note: Empty ZIv entry; name suggests amusement arcade on Scarborough sandside but no lineup evidence.

findings.name: Castaways Holiday Park
findings.evidence_quote: Used to be some old machines here. Games: Street Fighter II, Chase H.Q. Updated 2020-10-22.
findings.note: Old retro cabs only in 2020 note; no music games then, but stale. Bacton holiday park.

findings.name: Chatham Bowl
findings.evidence_quote: Leisure activities include a Pool Table, Arcade machines (Mostly Redemption), Air Hockey and lots more. Games: Minecraft Dungeons Arcade, Cruis'n Blast, Deadstorm Pirates Special Edition, Maxx X Grab Evolution. Updated 2024-01-30.
findings.note: Mostly redemption bowling FEC; no music games in list.

findings.name: Chesterfield Bowl
findings.evidence_quote: Has a very small arcade section as you walk in including some games I have not listed. No dance or rhythm games. Games: Dead Heat (2P), The Walking Dead. Updated 2024-12-30 by StaticFish.
findings.note: Explicit positive statement of no dance/rhythm games by UK ZIv regular, Dec 2024.

findings.name: Chill & Thrill
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: StepMania Converted Cabinet (International). Comment: Runs Stepmania 5.1, Has songs from 1st Mix to 7th Mix. Price Free Play. Condition Moderate. Retro Diner / Arcade. Updated 2025-07-22.
findings.note: Homebrew StepMania 5.1 pad cab, not commercial StepManiaX product, so slug other (not stepmaniax). Free play. Crewe Nantwich Rd.

findings.name: CineBowl
findings.evidence_quote: Mainly a Cinema and Bowling Alley, and only a few arcade games lie here. Games: Super Bikes, The House of the Dead 4, Claw Machine. Updated 2019-10-05.
findings.note: Uttoxeter cinema/bowl; explicit few arcade games, none music. Source 2019 so confidence unverified.

findings.name: Cineworld
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Claw Machine ... Comment: Left this machine as listed in case seasonal, however no sign of a claw machine [30/12/2024]. Updated 2024-12-30.
findings.note: Cineworld Chesterfield Alma Leisure Park lobby. Effectively no arcade floor / no rhythm games as of visit 2024-12-30.

findings.name: Cineworld
findings.evidence_quote: Games: Time Crisis 4. Comment 14 years ago: ITG Removed / Replaced with Euromix 1. Updated 2022-09-30. Burton-On-Trent Middleyard Leisure Park.
findings.note: ITG/Euromix historically present then gone; only Time Crisis 4 remains on list. Stale; confidence unverified. No current music games.

findings.name: Cineworld Bradford
findings.evidence_quote: Only a few arcade games in here. Go to Hollywood Bowl Bradford if you want more choice. Games: Allied Tank Attack, H2Overdrive, Terminator Salvation, Claw Machine, Key Master. Updated 2022-09-30.
findings.note: Small cinema lobby FEC; no music games. 2022 source → unverified for current floor.
